description: guard hooks. Logic lives in `scripts/guard_hook.py`; see `dev/design.md` for the design.

hooks.description: Deny a search rooted at the filesystem root — `find /`, `grep -r /`, `rg /` and the `fd`/`ag`/`ack`/`locate` equivalents, a `/`-anchored glob, or a Grep/Glob call whose `path` is `/`. Classifies the tool ARGUMENT and never the caller, so it ignores the agent switches and the mute. Silent for every other call, and fails open on a command it cannot parse.

When the user APPROVES a plan, hold it before it is built until it has been through the plan audit, and again whenever it is revised afterwards. Choosing "tell Claude what to change" runs no tool, so this never fires on feedback. A session opens with this armed; `guard-plan off` mutes it for that session. Only the user-supplied reviewer in `plan_review` runs; when unset, no plan review runs.

Add a source file, agent instruction file, saved reference or ordinary document to the session's pending checkpoint queue (including writes made by Bash and by subagents), and require a file saved inside the refs dir to be listed in the refs index (AGENTS.md).
Record reviewable files changed before a failing Bash command exited. Shell failure does not imply that earlier writes in the command were rolled back.
Recover reviewable files changed before an interrupted Bash command stopped. Emits no audit context; edited-file audits run only when the user invokes /guard:audit-files.

Sweep guard state and turn records past the retention window, record this session's transcript path (the one field guard cannot derive), export GUARD_PROJECT_DIR and GUARD_REFS_DIR, and state the refs rule as session context — plus, when review rules are configured, the entry points the user invokes.

When /clear ends a session, hand its session switches to the session replacing it. Matched on `clear` only: every other reason ends a session that is not being replaced. Writes nothing when both switches are muted.
